function bare<T>(x: T[never]): never { return x; }
function chained<T extends U, U>(x: T[never]): never { return x; }
function explicitIndexAsNever<T extends {[k:string]: number}>(x: T[never]): never { return x; }
function union<T>(x: (T | {a: 1})[never]): never { return x; }
function genericKey<T, K extends never>(x: T[K]): never { return x; }
console.log(bare<any>(123));
